title: SearchOutput
description: The post-oriented JSON document produced by the Recent Search command after collection starts.

status.description: How collection stopped: upstream pages exhausted, the CLI limit stopped collection while more results were available, or a failure interrupted collection.

incomplete_reason.description: Why collection stopped early. Present only when status is incomplete.

retrieved_at.description: UTC time at which this collection run started.

post_count.description: Number of posts saved after deduplication; equals the length of posts.

posts.description: Posts deduplicated by upstream post ID, including posts without external links. Always an array.

query.description: The X search expression before the language operator is added.

language.description: Optional X language code; omitted when not specified.

start_time.description: Optional RFC 3339 inclusive lower time bound; omitted when not specified.

end_time.description: Optional RFC 3339 exclusive upper time bound; omitted when not specified.

limit.description: Maximum number of deduplicated posts to save.

url.description: Canonical x.com URL for the post.

text.description: Post text, using full note-post text when X supplies it.

created_at.description: Upstream created_at value; empty when X omits it.

external_urls.description: External URL occurrences attached to the post; empty when it has none.

name.description: Author display name; empty when X omits it.

username.description: Author username; empty when X omits it.

short_url.description: Original shortened URL in the post.

expanded_url.description: Best expanded destination returned by X (unwound_url when available, otherwise expanded_url).
